propositions: Three independent code paths (normal compaction, fsck rebuild, crash recovery) each duplicate candidate listing, snapshot detection, snapshot envelope building, and retired file rename-back logic
Snapshot envelope builder and SNAPSHOT-path tests are hand-rolled in compact_txn and compact_rebuild with identical logic but no shared implementation
The retired rename-back rule appears three times with identical data-loss guards (remove uncommitted SNAPSHOT only after all reverse-renames succeed) but no consolidation

A rebuild includes stray non-.json files in source_event_uuids and renames them to *.retired, while normal compaction filters by .json suffix; this inconsistency is eliminated by requiring .json suffix in list_candidates

A new compact_plan module centralizes Candidate, snapshot testing, envelope building, retirement semantics, and commit logic to serve all three paths with single implementations verified to produce identical source_event_uuids
